parameter_rationale.legacy: This variant reproduces the saved post-hoc matched ablation and is retained only as an audit reference.
parameter_rationale.trajectory_id: Equal-distance candidates are ordered lexicographically by their immutable source trajectory identifier, providing a deterministic outcome-independent rule.
parameter_rationale.include_boundary: Every candidate tied at the kth distance is retained, removing dependence on arbitrary ordering at the truncation boundary.
parameter_rationale.top_k: The discovery sweep considered pools of 5, 10, and 20 and selected 10. The two remaining prespecified pool sizes are reused as sensitivity values rather than selected from evaluation outcomes.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap: The exact 10000-replicate user-then-trajectory resample plan saved by the matched-grid experiment is reused for every variant.
